entities.name: RABEPK
observations: The 372-residue query sequence exactly matches reviewed rat Rab9 effector protein Q4V8F4; alignment identity and coverage are 100%.
The protein contains multiple kelch-related beta-propeller domain signatures, including PF24681, PF07646, PF24981, and PF01344 calls.
RABEPK functions as a Rab9 effector required for endosome-to-trans-Golgi-network transport.
Reported localization is cytoplasm and endosome membrane; phosphorylation-dependent interaction with PIKFYVE recruits it to endosomal membranes.

entities.name: RAB9
observations: RABEPK interacts with RAB9 in its GTP-bound conformation.

entities.name: PIKFYVE
observations: Interaction with PIKFYVE and subsequent phosphorylation recruits RABEPK to the endosomal membrane.
